snippet.title: PRAISE TO THE MOON - STEAM REALEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
STEAM LINK: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4506630/Praise_To_The_Moon/
PRAISE TO THE MOON 
PTBR-
É um Metroidvania, baseado em Momodora, Castlevania e jogos do tipo Souls-Like, com sistemas de ARPG e anéis que têm vantagens e habilidades únicas, e o sistema de pactos onde cada pacto possui sua própria estatística que pode ajudar ou prejudicar você.
ENG-
It is a Metroidvania, based on Momodora, Castlevania, and Souls-like games, with ARPG systems and rings that have unique advantages and abilities, and the pact system where each pact has its own statistic that can help or harm you.  

Musicas por: Crowxzz, ALQUI, NKR NAMKER e SageLapis
